start_here: Say to your AI: "Perform one action explicitly offered by one of this person’s kept notices", with {"id":"told:1","action":"open"}. It runs tool:act-on-my-notice and answers {"done":true,"said":"Opening the sample page.","open":"/sample-page"}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (told-the-person) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Perform one action explicitly offered by one of this person’s kept notices", and give it id; action.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:act-on-my-notice and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Pass a notice id (told:<seq>) and the exact action id it offers; include text and a stable submission_id UUID for a reply.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: told-the-person (records:list); told-the-person (records:read, records:write); told-the-person (records:read, records:write).
